scope: Two-part sign-severity repair after direct endpoint mean regression failed on model_selection
decision_rule: Proceed to stochastic subset augmentation only if hurdle expected regret is learnable, improves over direct mean, preserves harm-sign signal, and has at least one nonzero coverage with cluster-bootstrap mean-regret CI upper at or below zero.
claim_boundary: Exploratory model-selection repair only; calibration and internal holdout remain unused.
